value.summary: Replay sanitized task events as JSON pages or resumable SSE
value.description: Authenticate every connection with the session cookie and check task ownership. Accept application/json (default) for bounded history or text/event-stream for task-event frames. SSE id is the task-local sequence, never the event resource UUID. Replays are strictly increasing and exclusive of the cursor. Last-Event-ID takes precedence over afterEventId only for SSE. Historical messages are fixed allowlisted summaries. READY/FAILED drains outstanding events then closes; EOF is not proof of task success. Query the task status, stop reconnecting at terminal state, and deduplicate by sequence. Unknown frames must not crash the client.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: SSE-only exclusive cursor. Canonical decimal int32 in [0,2147483647], default 0. A present header overrides afterEventId, including an invalid header; it is not used for JSON pages.

parameters.name: afterEventId
parameters.description: Exclusive task-local sequence cursor for JSON pages and SSE without Last-Event-ID. Canonical decimal int32, default 0. Empty, signed, padded, whitespace, UUID and overflow values fail with INVALID_EVENT_ID.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: JSON page size only; SSE backlog is always capped at 1000. Drain JSON pages by advancing afterEventId to the last applied sequence until a short or empty page, then subscribe at that cursor.

200.description: JSON history page or SSE stream. Task-local integer sequence is distinct from the UUID data.id. A terminal task at its head returns an empty SSE body and closes.

X-Accel-Buffering.description: SSE response requests no nginx buffering; deployment must also bound writes and sockets.

taskEvent.summary: Persisted event followed by a non-business heartbeat

streamError.summary: Post-header error has no id and closes the connection

terminalAtHead.summary: Terminal task with no remaining events

400.description: Invalid cursor (INVALID_EVENT_ID), page size (INVALID_EVENT_LIMIT), or typed scalar/task UUID (INVALID_REQUEST). Pre-stream errors are JSON even when Accept is text/event-stream.

409.description: EVENT_CURSOR_AHEAD: cursor exceeds this task's durable head. EVENT_BACKLOG_EXCEEDED: initial SSE backlog exceeds 1000; JSON page and then reconnect without dropping records.

500.description: INTERNAL_ERROR: inconsistent durable history, unknown stored state or other failure before streaming. No successful task state is implied.

503.description: EVENT_STREAM_CAPACITY: at most 64 active SSE connections per API instance.
